capabilities.title: List sessions
capabilities.summary: Inventory past agentic-CLI sessions from read-only source stores, filtered by an exact scope. Automated and trivial sessions are EXCLUDED by default: the result reports excluded_noise and matched alongside total, and total is a filtered count rather than everything on disk. Pass include_noise for the full set.

capabilities.title: Assay sessions
capabilities.summary: Classify a session's records into signal, exhaust, artifact and bookkeeping, and report reclaimable yield. Deterministic; never calls a model.

capabilities.title: Create a content seed
capabilities.summary: Build a portable xibodev.midden.seed/v1 bundle from an exact session scope: goal, redacted evidence with provenance, and an evidence digest. Deterministic; never calls a model.

capabilities.title: Extract evidence from sessions
capabilities.summary: Mine sessions into stored, redacted evidence: decisions, gotchas, error fixes, commands. This is the step between measuring a session and writing anything from it — content.produce draws on what this stores. Always calls a model through an AI CLI the user is already signed in to; there is no deterministic path to evidence.

capabilities.title: List producible content types
capabilities.summary: List the document types Midden can produce from mined evidence, which need a model and which are free, and how much stored evidence exists. Call this before content.produce.

capabilities.title: Produce content from mined evidence
capabilities.summary: Write a document from stored evidence. Deterministic packs are free and model-free; narrative outputs require an authorized model runtime. Call content.types for each kind's requirements and prefer recipes.compose when the host agent authors the draft.

capabilities.title: Submit authored drafts
capabilities.summary: Store host-authored content for every model-backed output in an approved recipe. No additional model call; retains evidence provenance and stops at draft review.

capabilities.title: List stored evidence
capabilities.summary: Inspect existing mined evidence before planning or re-extracting. Results are bounded and include evidence IDs.

capabilities.title: List recovery plans
capabilities.summary: List saved recovery production plans and their review status.

capabilities.title: Inspect a recovery plan
capabilities.summary: Read a recipe, its exact evidence, quality report, outputs and production runs.

capabilities.title: Preview a recovery plan
capabilities.summary: Design an evidence-grounded recipe without saving or generating content.

capabilities.title: Save a recovery plan
capabilities.summary: Save a draft recipe from intent, output kinds and evidence. Does not approve evidence or call a model.

capabilities.title: Revise a recovery plan
capabilities.summary: Revise the purpose or outputs of a saved plan. Invalidates prior evidence approval.

capabilities.title: Select plan evidence
capabilities.summary: Save an exact evidence set. Use decision approved only after the user reviews that set; approval does not produce outputs.

capabilities.title: Produce approved plan
capabilities.summary: Generate drafts from an approved recipe. Deterministic packs need no model; narrative outputs use the host-authorized model. Drafts still require review.

capabilities.title: Inspect output and provenance
capabilities.summary: Read draft bytes, provenance and content digest before review or revision.

capabilities.title: Revise or review an output
capabilities.summary: Save revised draft text or a user's review decision (draft, reviewed, rejected). Supply expected_digest from inspection to reject stale reviews.

capabilities.title: Export a reviewed output
capabilities.summary: Copy reviewed, digest-verified content and provenance to the local vault. Never publishes remotely.

capabilities.title: Render a delivery file
capabilities.summary: Render current Markdown to standalone HTML or slide source to editable PPTX with Pandoc. Tracks source and rendered digests; does not approve or publish.

capabilities.title: handoffs.create
capabilities.summary: Package reviewed project outputs with editorial context and provenance for Markdown, Quarto, Pandoc, D2 or an operator-controlled OpenMontage workspace. Local source files only; never renders, transfers or publishes.

capabilities.title: evidence.prepare
capabilities.summary: Prepare bounded, redacted source excerpts for the host agent. Exact source required; no model or writes.

capabilities.title: evidence.compose
capabilities.summary: Validate source-record citations and store host-authored extraction. Requires the current packet digest; never calls a model.

capabilities.title: projects.create
capabilities.summary: Create an exact multi-session editorial corpus from stored evidence. Human review and publication remain separate.

capabilities.title: projects.update
capabilities.summary: Replace a corpus or goal using a revision fence. Preserves history and marks previous analysis stale.

capabilities.title: projects.list
capabilities.summary: List bounded editorial project summaries with total, offset and limit.

capabilities.title: projects.inspect
capabilities.summary: Inspect a project or historical revision, including opportunities, chapter plans and recipe links.

capabilities.title: editorial.prepare
capabilities.summary: Prepare bounded evidence and investigative guidance for the host agent. Reports scope and estimated input tokens; no nested model call.

capabilities.title: editorial.analyze
capabilities.summary: Store host-authored editorial analysis after validating claims, source references, reversals and chapter dependencies. Not editorial approval.

capabilities.title: editorial.select
capabilities.summary: Select one opportunity into a draft recipe. Does not approve its evidence or produce content. Unresolved gaps need explicit disclosure.

xibodev.midden.content.produce.request/v.title: Content production request
xibodev.midden.content.produce.request/v.description: Write one document from stored evidence. Deterministic packs call no model; narrative kinds require an explicitly authorized model runtime. Requires the midden_home root. Prefer recipes.compose for host-authored drafts.

kind.description: Output type from content.types. Inspect requires_model and free_kinds before authorizing production.

session_id.description: Narrow evidence to ONE session. Everything upstream is session-addressed; without this, scoping to a session silently becomes a workspace filter that widens as more sessions are mined.

evidence_kinds.description: Narrow to evidence kinds: decision, gotcha, error_fix, command, artifact, dead_end.

max_evidence.description: Bound on evidence used. 0 selects the default of 40.

name.description: Output filename stem, a single safe path segment.

xibodev.midden.content.types.request/v1.title: content.types request
xibodev.midden.content.types.request/v1.description: content.types takes no input. Any properties supplied are ignored.

xibodev.midden.evidence.extract.request/.title: Evidence extraction request
xibodev.midden.evidence.extract.request/.description: Mine sessions into stored, redacted evidence. ALWAYS calls a model through an already-authenticated AI CLI: there is no deterministic path to evidence. Requires the midden_home write root and subprocess authority.

ids.description: Exact session identifiers. Each session costs a model call, so an exact scope is cheaper as well as more accurate.

max_sessions.description: Bound on sessions mined. 0 selects the default of 3. Each one is a separate model call.

max_records.description: Bound on candidate records sent per session. 0 selects the default of 40. This governs real cost more than the session count does.

session_id.description: Exact session ID, not a prefix.

xibodev.midden.seed.create.request/v1.title: Midden seed creation request
xibodev.midden.seed.create.request/v1.description: Build a portable content seed from an exact session scope. Deterministic; never calls a model. Requires the midden_home write root.

ids.description: Exact session identifiers. Strongly preferred over an inferred scope: a seed built from the wrong sessions is worse than no seed.

max_evidence.description: Bound on evidence records carried by the seed. 0 selects the default of 40.

goal.description: What the seed is for. The one field a useful seed should always carry.

suggested_output_types.description: Advisory hint. Deliberately not enumerated here: the consuming creative lane owns this vocabulary, so enumerating it in Midden's schema would make every new output type a breaking change in the wrong repository.

brief.description: Override the generated prose brief. Optional.

name.description: Seed directory name, a single safe path segment. Generated when absent.

attach.description: Documents to carry into the seed, as paths RELATIVE to the midden_home root — the same path value content.produce returns. This is how a seed carries the brief written from its evidence rather than the evidence alone. Paths escaping the root are refused, and files are copied by basename into attachments/.

xibodev.midden.sessions.assay.request/v1.title: Midden assay request
xibodev.midden.sessions.assay.request/v1.description: Deterministic classification of session records. Never calls a model.

max_sessions.description: Bound on sessions assayed. 0 selects the default of 25.

max_candidates.description: Bound on candidate records tracked per session. 0 selects the default of 40.

xibodev.midden.sessions.list.request/v1.title: Midden session scope
xibodev.midden.sessions.list.request/v1.description: An exact scope over read-only source stores. The zero value matches everything, so callers should narrow deliberately.

days.description: Only sessions touched in the last n calendar days. 0 is unbounded.

workspace.description: Substring match against the session directory.

ids.description: Exact session identifiers. Preferred over inferred scope.

include_noise.description: Include automated or trivial sessions. They are EXCLUDED by default, so total is a filtered count; the result reports excluded_noise and matched so the figure carries its own denominator.

max_sessions.description: Bound on sessions returned. 0 selects the default of 25.

evidence_count.description: How many evidence items the document was derived from.

empty.description: The document was written and has no content, because the evidence in scope contains nothing this kind can use. Distinct from success: a preference pack needs dead_end items to pair against.

model_used.description: A fact about this production, not a promise about the capability.

review.description: Always draft. Producing a document is not approving it.

media_type.description: Every output is SOURCE TEXT. A d2 file is a diagram's source, not a rendered diagram.

maker.description: The tool a person runs NEXT on this source. A handoff target, not a dependency Midden invokes.

evidence_count.description: Stored evidence available. Zero means nothing can be produced regardless of type.

free_kinds.description: Kinds producible with no model call.

redacted.description: How many stored items had credential-shaped content replaced.

slice_bytes.description: What was actually sent to the model.

stored.description: Evidence items written to the index.

empty.description: Sessions the model read and found nothing reusable in. Separate from failed: stored=0 with failed=0 is otherwise indistinguishable from a broken extraction.

by_kind.description: Composition of what was found: decision, gotcha, error_fix, command, artifact, dead_end. A reader judging whether extraction was worthwhile needs this, not just a total.

model_used.description: Always true on success. There is no deterministic path to evidence.

root.description: Logical root name the path is relative to.

path.description: Seed directory, RELATIVE to the named root. Never absolute: an absolute path would be unverifiable by the host and meaningless to a consumer reading a staged copy.

manifest_path.description: Entry file, relative to the same root.

evidence_digest.description: sha256 over evidence.jsonl, bare lowercase hex. Scoped to the evidence set, not the bundle, so regenerating brief prose does not invalidate a provenance claim.

evidence_count.description: Zero is valid: a goal with no recovered material is a legitimate seed.

xibodev.midden.sessions.assay.result/v1.title: Midden assay result
xibodev.midden.sessions.assay.result/v1.description: Per-session composition and reclaimable yield. Candidate record previews are drawn from private transcripts and are deliberately not returned.

counts.description: Record counts by class: signal, exhaust, artifact, bookkeeping.

by_kind.description: Tool-native record kind breakdown, which is what makes a pruning decision defensible.

total.description: Sessions matching the scope AFTER the noise filter. This is not the number of files on disk.

excluded_noise.description: Sessions the scope matched but the noise filter removed. Report this alongside total: a filtered count stated alone reads as a complete one.

matched.description: total + excluded_noise: everything the scope matched before filtering.

noise_filter_applied.description: Whether automated and trivial sessions were excluded. True unless include_noise was set.

truncated.description: The scope matched more than max_sessions; the list is partial while total remains the full filtered count.

xibodev.midden.content.output/v1.title: Midden content output
xibodev.midden.content.output/v1.description: A document produced from mined evidence. Always SOURCE TEXT: markdown, jsonl, json, tsv, d2 source or a diff. Midden renders nothing.

xibodev.midden.seed/v1.title: Midden content seed manifest
xibodev.midden.seed/v1.description: Entry file of a seed bundle directory containing manifest.json, brief.md, evidence.jsonl, provenance.json and attachments/. Portable: readable with no Midden binary, index, or environment. Every internal path is relative to the seed root, and the digest rather than the path is the stable identity.

attachments.description: Paths relative to the seed root. Never absolute, never referencing Midden internals.

suggested_output_types.description: Advisory. An unrecognised value degrades to no suggestion rather than failing the seed.

skills.title: Editorial production
skills.summary: Use when discovering stories, lessons, content opportunities, or long-form projects in agentic history.

skills.title: Recovering a session
skills.summary: Finding, assaying and carrying forward a session that cannot be resumed.

skills.title: Selecting evidence
skills.summary: Reading assay classes and choosing the bounded slice worth keeping.

skills.title: Content seeds
skills.summary: Building and describing a portable xibodev.midden.seed/v1 bundle.
